import json, hashlib, hmac, random, time

SECRET=b"experiment-only-host-key"
OPS=["READ","WRITE_VERSION","REPOINT","DEPLOY","SEND","PAY"]

def enc(o): return json.dumps(o,sort_keys=True,separators=(",",":")).encode()
def H(o): return hashlib.sha256(enc(o)).hexdigest()
def sign(p): return hmac.new(SECRET,enc(p),hashlib.sha256).hexdigest()
def payload(p):
    return {k:p[k] for k in ("intent_hash","basis_hash","selection_hash","revocation_epoch","expires_epoch","capability_scope","nonce")}
def sigok(p): return hmac.compare_digest(sign(payload(p)),p["signature"])

def ref(c):
    i,p,s=c["intent"],c["permit"],c["current"]
    checks=[
      sigok(p), H(i)==p["intent_hash"], s["basis"]==p["basis_hash"],
      s["selection"]==p["selection_hash"], s["revocation"]==p["revocation_epoch"],
      s["epoch"]<=p["expires_epoch"], s["closure"]=="KNOWN_VALID",
      i["operation"] in p["capability_scope"]]
    return all(checks)

def lowered(c,drop=None):
    i,p,s=c["intent"],c["permit"],c["current"]
    ck={
      "signature":sigok(p),
      "intent":H(i)==p["intent_hash"],
      "basis":s["basis"]==p["basis_hash"],
      "selection":s["selection"]==p["selection_hash"],
      "revocation":s["revocation"]==p["revocation_epoch"],
      "expiry":s["epoch"]<=p["expires_epoch"],
      "closure":s["closure"]=="KNOWN_VALID",
      "scope":i["operation"] in p["capability_scope"]}
    if drop: ck[drop]=True
    return all(ck.values())

def valid(seed):
    r=random.Random(seed); op=r.choice(OPS)
    b=hashlib.sha256(("b"+str(seed)).encode()).hexdigest()
    s=hashlib.sha256(("s"+str(seed)).encode()).hexdigest()
    i={"operation":op,"args":{"target":"r"+str(seed%1000),"value":seed%99991},
       "semantic_hash":hashlib.sha256(("sem"+str(seed)).encode()).hexdigest(),
       "contract_hash":hashlib.sha256(("con"+str(seed)).encode()).hexdigest(),
       "basis_hash":b,"selection_hash":s,"closure_state":"KNOWN_VALID",
       "risk_class":r.choice(["LOW","MEDIUM","HIGH"])}
    cur=100+seed%31
    pp={"intent_hash":H(i),"basis_hash":b,"selection_hash":s,"revocation_epoch":seed%17,
        "expires_epoch":cur+5,"capability_scope":[op],"nonce":format(seed,"x")}
    p=dict(pp); p["signature"]=sign(pp)
    return {"intent":i,"permit":p,"current":{"basis":b,"selection":s,"revocation":seed%17,"epoch":cur,"closure":"KNOWN_VALID"}}

axes=["signature","scope","revocation","expiry","basis","selection","closure","intent"]
per_axis=2500
false_accept={a:0 for a in axes}
good_denies=0
mismatch=0
for j,a in enumerate(axes):
  for k in range(per_axis):
    c=valid(100000+j*per_axis+k)
    if a=="signature": c["permit"]["signature"]="0"*64
    elif a=="scope":
      p=c["permit"]; p["capability_scope"]=[x for x in OPS if x!=c["intent"]["operation"]][:1]
      p["signature"]=sign(payload(p))
    elif a=="revocation": c["current"]["revocation"]+=1
    elif a=="expiry": c["current"]["epoch"]=c["permit"]["expires_epoch"]+1
    elif a=="basis": c["current"]["basis"]=hashlib.sha256(("db"+str(k)).encode()).hexdigest()
    elif a=="selection": c["current"]["selection"]=hashlib.sha256(("ds"+str(k)).encode()).hexdigest()
    elif a=="closure": c["current"]["closure"]="UNKNOWN" if k%2==0 else "KNOWN_INVALID"
    elif a=="intent": c["intent"]["args"]["value"]+=1
    rr=ref(c); ll=lowered(c)
    mismatch += rr!=ll
    good_denies += not ll
    false_accept[a] += lowered(c,a)

benign=10000; benign_allowed=0
for k in range(benign):
    c=valid(900000+k)
    rr=ref(c); ll=lowered(c)
    mismatch += rr!=ll
    benign_allowed += ll

# mixed mutation fuzz
r=random.Random(20260809); mixed=30000; mixed_mismatch=0; mixed_bad=0
for k in range(mixed):
    c=valid(2000000+k)
    if r.random()<.10: c["current"]["basis"]=hashlib.sha256(("x"+str(k)).encode()).hexdigest()
    if r.random()<.10: c["current"]["selection"]=hashlib.sha256(("y"+str(k)).encode()).hexdigest()
    if r.random()<.07: c["current"]["revocation"]+=1
    if r.random()<.07: c["current"]["epoch"]=c["permit"]["expires_epoch"]+1
    if r.random()<.08: c["current"]["closure"]="UNKNOWN"
    if r.random()<.07: c["intent"]["args"]["value"]+=1
    if r.random()<.04: c["permit"]["signature"]="f"*64
    rr=ref(c); ll=lowered(c)
    mixed_mismatch += rr!=ll
    if (not rr) and ll: mixed_bad += 1

print(json.dumps({
 "experiment":"EXP-CC-RC1.9-CBEL-TV-E2B-001",
 "targeted_cases":len(axes)*per_axis,
 "benign_cases":benign,
 "mixed_fuzz_cases":mixed,
 "good_checker_targeted_denies":good_denies,
 "good_checker_benign_allows":benign_allowed,
 "reference_vs_lowered_mismatches":mismatch,
 "mixed_reference_vs_lowered_mismatches":mixed_mismatch,
 "mixed_false_accepts":mixed_bad,
 "mutant_false_accepts_when_one_check_removed":false_accept,
 "claim_boundary":"finite constructed runtime experiment; not formal proof or full syscall sandbox red-team"
},sort_keys=True))
